A Birthday Note From The Heart

I wanna say Happy Birthday, Darling! So here it goes, I know that its not that long ever since we met but I want you to know that you are now memorable and a precious human being in my life HAHAHA. You are the sweetest and most caring friend I know, you are so vulnerable that I really worry a lot. But hey, remember that I will always be there for you and I will always have your back. I wish that everything you wanna achieve in life will be fulfilled, for you to be always in good health, and to always spread your one of a kind kindness. Don't cry when I'm not there, and don't always carry your problems alone. You are LOVED, know that! I love you and thankful to you, for having along patience whenever we talk, and for making me feel comfortable that anyone else. You are so young and yet you are so sensible and caring. Salamat din because you made me feel special and important, ikaw na yan eh, oa lagi sa pageexpress (but i love that part of u). And lastly, I pray that all of your dreams and wishes may come true, because you deserve it. I LOVE YOU SO MUCH, DARLING! ❤ HAPPY BIRTHDAY! 💖🎂✨ ps. di yan chatgpt ha
